structure.description: 视线自山脚仰向高峰，主峰以纵向势能统领画面，层云和山脚承托其高耸。

subject_rules.primary: place a towering principal peak above the viewer; do not flatten it into a western horizon view

zones: mist, sky, and breathing intervals between mountain masses

generation.style: high-distance spatial logic, layered ink values, mobile viewing rather than a single camera vanishing point
